boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Juniata study environments, from technology-rich collaboration areas to quiet rooms and academic-building lounges.

cards.title: Settle In by the Café
cards.subtitle: Living-room seating for flexible study sessions
cards.notes: Bring reading or laptop work to the main-level living room, with printing and the café close enough for an easy change of pace.
cards.short_summary: A central, informal workspace beside practical student services.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata's 2025–2026 catalog identifies a main-level living room with a café, information desk, printing, and nearby individual and group study areas.
cards.access_notes: Statton is open Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–midnight, Friday 8 a.m.–8 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m., and Sunday 10 a.m.–midnight; special schedules may supersede these hours.

cards.entity_name: Statton Learning Commons Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Switch Off the Group Chat
cards.subtitle: A designated area for quiet individual work
cards.notes: Choose this designated quiet zone when the assignment calls for sustained reading, drafting, or review without a group-work setup.
cards.short_summary: A purpose-designated setting for concentrated solo study.
cards.evidence_claim: The current Juniata catalog states that Statton Learning Commons includes a designated quiet study area.
cards.access_notes: Use during Statton building hours: Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–midnight, Friday 8 a.m.–8 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m., and Sunday 10 a.m.–midnight.

cards.entity_name: Statton Learning Commons Group Study Areas
cards.title: Put the Shared Screen to Work
cards.subtitle: Technology-rich spaces for collaborative assignments
cards.notes: Bring the project team here when you need a shared workspace; select an open group area and confirm any posted reservation requirement.
cards.short_summary: Technology-equipped spaces designed around collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata's current catalog documents technology-rich group study areas on Statton's main level, while the college's project page describes small-group rooms with built-in technology.
cards.access_notes: The cited catalog does not specify whether each group area requires a reservation; check room signage or the information desk before settling in.

cards.title: Read beside the Water Fountain
cards.subtitle: Second-floor room for contemplative work
cards.notes: Use the meditation books, sound machine, and kinetic fountain as a low-stimulation backdrop for reflective reading or a planning reset.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor retreat furnished for quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata identifies a second-floor Statton meditation room containing a kinetic water fountain, sound machine, affirmation cards, and meditation books.
cards.access_notes: The room follows Statton Learning Commons hours; the official building schedule lists Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–midnight, Friday 8 a.m.–8 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m., and Sunday 10 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Pair the Desk with Academic Help
cards.subtitle: Main-level workspace near coaching and tutoring
cards.notes: Work nearby when an assignment may benefit from academic support; drop-ins are accepted, though scheduling an appointment is preferred.
cards.short_summary: A study-support base with access to coaching and peer resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata places the Academic Resources Center on Statton's main level and says drop-ins are welcome while appointments are preferred.
cards.access_notes: Academic Resources lists office hours of 8:30 a.m.–4 p.m. Monday–Friday. Drop-ins are welcome, but appointments are preferred.

cards.entity_name: von Liebig Center for Science Study Lounges
cards.title: Spread Out between Science Classes
cards.subtitle: Study lounges inside the science center
cards.notes: Use a lounge for problem sets or lab-note review, keeping seminar rooms and specialized laboratories clear unless your course authorizes them.
cards.short_summary: Science-building lounges suited to between-class academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata's facility page states that the von Liebig Center for Science contains study lounges as well as a microcomputer laboratory and seminar rooms.
cards.access_notes: VLB is open Monday–Thursday 6 a.m.–1 a.m., Friday 6 a.m.–11 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m.–11 p.m., and Sunday 9 a.m.–1 a.m.

cards.title: Choose a Lounge on Any Level
cards.subtitle: Group-study spaces distributed through Good Hall
cards.notes: Meet collaborators in one of the building's lounge spaces, then move to individual work without occupying a scheduled classroom.
cards.short_summary: Multiple renovated lounges support gathering and group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata's 2023 institutional self-study says Good Hall renovations created lounge spaces for gathering and group study on every level.
cards.access_notes: Good Hall is open Monday–Thursday 6 a.m.–1 a.m., Friday 6 a.m.–11 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m.–11 p.m., and Sunday 9 a.m.–1 a.m.

cards.entity_name: Brumbaugh Academic Center Entrance Study Space
cards.title: Gather at the BAC Entrance
cards.subtitle: A documented group-study area near the entrance
cards.notes: Use the entrance study area for collaborative prep, especially when teammates need an easy-to-identify meeting point inside BAC.
cards.short_summary: An accessible rendezvous for group work in the academic center.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata's institutional self-study documents a group-gathering and study space incorporated into the renovated Brumbaugh Academic Center entrance.
cards.access_notes: BAC is open Monday–Thursday 6 a.m.–1 a.m., Friday 6 a.m.–11 p.m., Saturday 9 a.m.–11 p.m., and Sunday 9 a.m.–1 a.m.

cards.title: Take a Table between Classes
cards.subtitle: A private lounge for transfer and commuter students
cards.notes: If you are a transfer or commuter student, use the study tables, comfortable seating, nearby printing, and 24/7 access between classes.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock study lounge serving eligible commuter and transfer students.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata says the Aspire Center provides transfer and commuter students with study tables, comfortable seating, a private quiet space, nearby printing, and 24/7 access.
cards.access_notes: Access is specifically for transfer and commuter students and is available 24/7. The center is at the back of the lower-level 24/7 Lounge in Ellis Hall.

cards.entity_name: Juniata College Museum of Art Communal Tables
cards.title: Work with Art in View
cards.subtitle: Communal tables and floor seating inside the museum
cards.notes: Bring visual notes, sketching, or light reading during gallery hours; use the communal tables while respecting exhibitions and programs.
cards.short_summary: A museum setting with tables, floor seating, and creative materials.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata states that its Museum of Art provides communal tables, floor seating areas, art kits, and creative stress-relief activities.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists hours Monday–Thursday 1–8 p.m. and Saturday noon–4 p.m.; it lists no Friday or Sunday hours.
